topic: The Impossible Chessboard: Decoding Information Theory through Strategy

sections.title: The Hook: A High-Stakes Game
lecture_lines: A prisoner must guess a hidden coin's state.
The board contains sixty-four coins, randomly placed.
Can one flip guarantee the prisoner's survival?

sections.title: Prerequisite: Parity and Binary States
lecture_lines: Parity tracks if coin sums are even or odd.
Heads is one, tails is zero in binary.
Toggling a coin flips the board's total parity.
animations: Display a binary switch labeled '0' and '1' (#E0FFFF) with an icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg] representing the binary unit.
Visualize parity check as a flipping toggle (#90EE90).

sections.title: The Strategy: Mapping Information to Coordinates
lecture_lines: Each of the sixty-four squares has a unique coordinate.
Calculate the XOR sum of all Heads indices.
This sum pinpoints the square needing a flip.
Mapping coordinates encodes information onto the board.
This strategy aligns parity with a target state.

Represent data points as light pink (#FFB6C1) circles on grid.

Show coordinate movement with smooth light gray (#D3D3D3) paths.

sections.title: The Solution: Information Theory in Action
lecture_lines: The board state represents sixty-four bits of data.
Flipping one coin encodes the target square's index.
The XOR sum now points to the guesser's square.
Information theory allows us to solve the puzzle.
The prisoner effectively communicates via the board's parity.
animations: Display raw data stream using light violet (#EE82EE) characters alongside the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/board.svg].
Visualize compression algorithm with light salmon (#FFA07A) shapes.
Show reduced data stream using light lime (#BFFF00) characters, representing the output as a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion: The Power of Compressed Communication
lecture_lines: We compressed information into the board's state.
The impossible task is solved through smart encoding.
Strategic communication grants the prisoners their freedom.
